liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Away From The Mire** (1 review): Track marking splits this song mid-jam, with the remainder of the jam labeled as the next track [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **If Your Hair Is Too Long**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [13]
- **There's Sin In Your Heart**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **Pig In A Pen**: back after 66 archived shows (475 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [13]
- **Dreadful Wind & Rain**: back after 63 archived shows (467 days); rare: 11 archived performances [13]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2025-08-01.mk4** (recommended): source not stated; 14 songs; 87 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer ranks this recording, with the MK2 version, as the best of the show; track splits are awkward [12]
- **billystrings2025-08-01.SchoepsMK41V.Tremblay.Flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 14 songs; 78 min [2]
- **billystrings2025-08-01.spyder9.flac16**: source not stated; 14 songs; 78 min [4]
- **billystrings2025-08-01.ejl6495**: source not stated; 14 songs; 78 min [5]
- **billystrings2025-08-01**: source not stated; 14 songs; 78 min [6]

## Around the show

- Band performed celebrating 60 years of the Grateful Dead's music, gathered around one can mic at the front of the stage [2]
- Lineup: William Apostol on guitar, Billy Failing on banjo, Royal Masat on bass, Jarrod Walker on mandolin; Andy Lytle mixed front of house [2]
- First day of the GD60 shows in San Francisco, running August 1-3, 2025 [4]
- Played at the Polo Fields, Golden Gate Park, as part of a celebration of 60 years of Grateful Dead music [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2025-08-01.mk4**: taped by Oren Levy; transferred by Oren Levy; source: Schoeps MK4 30/60 > Mixpre 6 II [1]
- **billystrings2025-08-01.SchoepsMK41V.Tremblay.Flac24**: taped by John Tremblay; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: Schoeps CCM 41V's (15ft Directly behind in the board) [2]. Also: Schoeps CCM 41V mics, 15 feet behind the board in the taper section; SD card to Audacity, 24-bit dither, tagged in Foobar2000 [2]
- **billystrings2025-08-01.spyder9.flac16**: taped by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; transferred by Dan Nolan, Jr. - spyder9; source: Schoeps CMC 1 KC5 mk22 > Zoom F6 (24/44.1) [4]
- **billystrings2025-08-01.ejl6495**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: Channels 1 & 2: B9 Audio C31F Wide Cardioids > nbob actives > baby nbox > Tascam Fr-AV2 32 bit float/ 96 [5]. Also: Taped in the official tapers section left of the board, about 14 feet high; SD to WAV to Reaper to FLAC 24 [5]
- **billystrings2025-08-01**: taped by Z-Man; transferred by Z-Man; source: Schoeps CCM4V'S>Sound Devices Mix-Pre 6 II (48/32) [6]. Also: Schoeps CCM4V mics into a Sound Devices Mix-Pre 6 II, about 8.5 feet high; recorded and seeded by Z-Man; Processing went through Sound Forge 10.0 and CD Wave to 16-bit FLAC, tagged in Foobar 2000 [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by tela.sugarmegs.org: [Sugarmegs Audio Setlist](https://tela.sugarmegs.org/_asxtela/asxcards/BillyStrings2025-08-01GoldenGateParkSanFranciscoCA.html) [14]
